- Novus Health: treat as co-sell. Require MAP signed by both partners and customer; we will not change primary ownership until MAP executed.
- Meridian Grocers: grant BrightStack a 45-day procurement exclusion window (Nov 15 – Dec 30) to run procurement. During exclusion, other partner outreach must be paused; BrightStack to provide weekly progress notes.

- Marcus: implement canary routing in production for Acme (start 2026-11-08).
- Soojin: schedule a 30-min partner sync w/ CloudForge + BrightStack to confirm MAP template and exclusion terms (target 2026-11-10).
